text: A central pattern generator (CPG) is the biological motif the lab reproduces. What defines a CPG?
choices: A circuit that amplifies a rhythmic sensory input into a larger motor output
A neural circuit that produces rhythmic motor output (e.g. locomotion, breathing) without requiring any rhythmic or sensory input
A feedback controller that needs continuous proprioceptive input to stay in time
A supervised classifier that labels gait phases from camera images
explanation: A CPG generates rhythmic output autonomously: no rhythmic drive or sensory feedback is required (Ijspeert 2008). The lab shows a trained reservoir sustaining a gait rhythm with zero external input. Options 0 and 2 wrongly make the rhythm depend on external or sensory input; option 3 is unrelated to rhythm generation.
